explanation: From the parent side, one category can be related to many child categories, while each child points back to one parent. That is a recursive one-to-many relationship. The parent/child perspective matters here: the same structure can be described as many-to-one from child to parent, but the question explicitly asks from parent to child.
prompt: A table `Category(category_id, parent_category_id)` stores categories where `parent_category_id` references `Category.category_id`. From the parent-category perspective, if one parent category can have several child categories and each child category has one parent, what recursive cardinality is being modeled?
